tracking_sync.scope: Planning synchronization only. Exact committed/pushed checkpoint, external seal, dual positive preflights, independent checkpoint review and explicit two-path dispatch remain required. All implementation/runtime/release authorities remain false.

design.boundary: Pure local standard-library preparation only. No runtime override, config endpoint, npm/build integration, image operation, network, ambient environment, secret lookup, subprocess or default output file. No future artifact admission command.

interface.library: evaluate_files(*, manifest: Path, approval: Path, policies: dict[str, Path], build_recipe: Path, embed_source: Path) -> dict[str, object]
interface.cli: python3 scripts/dev/workshop_merchant_manifest.py --manifest PATH --approval PATH --policy terms=PATH --policy privacy=PATH --policy refund=PATH --policy contact=PATH --build-recipe PATH --embed-source PATH
interface.output: One deterministic JSON object to stdout; no input content, policy text, URLs, account/Price IDs or exception strings echoed. Exit0 prepared_offline; exit3 blocked; argparse usage exit2. No writes or optional network behavior.

input_limits.all_reads: Explicit regular files only; reject symlinks/directories/nonregular files, bound reads to limit+1, require strict UTF-8 for manifest/envelope, reject BOM, duplicate keys at every nesting level, non-finite numbers and unknown/missing keys. Never parse policy snapshots; hash their exact bytes.

design.manifest_rules: Prospective candidate enabled must be exact boolean true; terms_version literal workshop-v1; tax_notice nonblank UTF-8 string with no controls except LF/tab; four URLs nonblank absolute HTTPS with hostname, no whitespace/control/userinfo, fragments, invalid port or backslash. No URL normalization before comparison. Real-owner provenance rejects localhost/IP literals, .localhost/.local/.test/.invalid/.example and example.com/net/org plus their subdomains, and /fixture or /fixtures path segments. Synthetic provenance permits reserved test hosts and fixture paths. This check is syntax only: the exact reviewed URL string and snapshot digest remain authoritative; no publication claim.

approval_closed_fields.owner_approval_ref: nonempty string <=2048; reference only, never authenticated by tool

policies.terms|privacy|refund|contact: each exactly {url: exact corresponding manifest URL string, sha256: raw snapshot digest, bytes: positive integer excluding bool}

tax.notice_sha256: SHA256 of decoded manifest tax_notice encoded UTF-8, without normalization

design.identity_rules: Verify source SHA/tree against spec constants; they are admitted source declarations, not proof of a local checkout. Hash actual explicitly supplied build_recipe and embed_source files and compare against both envelope and pins. Hash original manifest/snapshots exactly once as bounded bytes; preserve those bytes and never reserialize an approved manifest. All nested schemas closed. Digests use lowercase 64-hex. All integer comparisons reject bool. No timestamps, caller-declared approved/test_passed booleans, mutable image tags or artifact fields accepted.

result_closed_fields.manifest_sha256: raw hash when readable, else null
result_closed_fields.manifest_bytes: actual length when readable, else null
result_closed_fields.baseline_disabled: true only for exact pinned 168-byte disabled baseline
result_closed_fields.reasons: sorted unique stable reason codes, no supplied text
result_closed_fields.authorities: every key from task authorities false

design.status_semantics: prepared_offline requires every supplied local file, strict schema, tuple and digest consistent; it can use synthetic inputs with explicit provenance. Owner_supplied_unverified still conveys zero owner/authenticity credit. Missing future artifacts and real TEST evidence do not prevent prepared_offline because this lane cannot verify them. Missing/malformed local inputs or mutations yield blocked. Exact disabled shipped baseline is valid baseline evidence and blocked for preparation by merchant_inputs_pending, not labeled malformed. No enabled candidate is copied to shipped path.
design.later_separate_gate: Owner must independently approve exact Terms/Privacy/Refund/Contact HTTPS URLs, policy/contact snapshots and tax/final-price decision. If tax obligations require extra collection, block for separate payment design; current Checkout has no automatic_tax/tax_rates. Later approved injection/rebuild seals manifest/build inputs before producing image identity, then binds actual OCI digest (and platform digest for multiarch), actual compiled binary digest and actual extracted/served manifest equality. Authentic Stripe TEST account/Price and checkout/webhook/durable grant/duplicate/revocation evidence must bind the same product/policies/manifest/artifact tuple; caller flags and copied fixtures do not prove it. TEST never admits stripe_live. No circular self-hash or mutable tag proof.
